findings.section: §8 warmup rule vs §5 VOL-DRIFT/OPEN-GAP state formation (and D1 manifest required contents)
findings.quote_bytes: warmup = max(60, family max lookback) completed bars (64 for the 63-lookback VOL-DRIFT configs), first decision bar = warmup + 1
findings.why_wrong: The frozen warmup rule counts only the state estimator lookback and is contradicted by two of the five families whose states require 252-bar trailing windows. VOL-DRIFT's own §5 definition is 'boundaries from the TRAILING 252-bar window ending at and including bar t, refreshed daily'; with warmup 64 (explicitly pinned for the L=63 configs) at most ~2 estimator observations exist at the first decision bar, so tercile boundaries are undefined or degenerate. OPEN-GAP thresholds are percentiles of the 'trailing 252-bar gap distribution', which requires >=253 completed bars, while the same max(60, lookback) reading pins 60. The D1 manifest is REQUIRED to contain 'the warmup rule (§8)', so the contradiction is carried into the frozen contract verbatim; a byte-faithful implementation cannot form states for 10 of 33 configurations (6 OPEN-GAP + 4 VOL-DRIFT), and the only escape is an improvised expanding-window convention outside the freeze. That improvised convention changes which bars fire, hence fired censuses, R2 floors, fold populations, D2 survival, and therefore the scored selection. Conclusion-changing in a pre-registration freeze -> HIGH.
evidence_paths: plans/PLAN_forex_search_v1.md (§5 VOL-DRIFT and OPEN-GAP family definitions; §5 required-manifest list; §8 decision row)
plans/PLAN_forex_ng7.md (§8 lineage: warmup 60 for a single-lookback family, no auxiliary 252-bar window)
findings.required_remediation: In plan bytes before D1: pin warmup per family INCLUDING auxiliary trailing windows — e.g. OPEN-GAP >= 253 completed bars (252 gaps), VOL-DRIFT >= 252 + L - 1 for the boundary window — or freeze an explicit causal expanding-window boundary contract (with a minimum-observation floor and disclosure) as the law; make the §8 parenthetical consistent with whichever is chosen, so the D1 manifest inherits an uncontradicted rule.

findings.quote_bytes: marked STATED-CONSERVATIVE — charged uniformly across legs regardless of sign ... the D1 manifest prints source bytes, arithmetic and these caveats verbatim
findings.why_wrong: The 1.7 bps/night charge is 5.1/3 — a 3-night CUMULATIVE AVERAGE presented under the label 'conservative worst-night band'. The plan itself discloses the average does not bound the single worst night, so an adverse leg-night with a true debit above the stressed 3.4 bps (1.7 x 2.0) would be under-charged and could flip an R1 verdict on a survivor. This does NOT reopen the NG6/NG7 fail-closed class — the charge is nonzero, pre-frozen, uniform, sign-invariant, stress-2.0 primary, single-session-bounded, dual-books-fixture-guarded, with break-even bps reported per arm, and the caveats are DISCLOSED in the bytes — but the caveat's carriage requirement stops at the D1 manifest: §10's mandatory result language carries only the §3 relaxation disclosure, so a terminal SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY outcome could propagate without the financing caveat adjacent to it. MEDIUM (disclosed, bounded residual; no result exists yet to flip).

findings.section: §5 grid — VOL-DRIFT estimator and OPEN-GAP percentile input under-pinned
findings.quote_bytes: estimator = close-to-close log-return std over the trailing lookback L; boundaries from the TRAILING 252-bar window ending at and including bar t, refreshed daily, same-bar assignment — NEVER full-sample
findings.why_wrong: The 'pinned' estimator leaves free parameters: (i) ddof (population vs sample std) unstated; (ii) construction of the 252-bar boundary sample unstated — 252 overlapping daily L-bar estimates vs non-overlapping 252/L sub-windows give materially different tercile boundaries for L in {21,63}; (iii) whether the current estimate E_t participates in its own boundary sample unstated (causal either way, but a convention that changes assignments); (iv) OPEN-GAP 'gap size threshold' does not state whether percentiles are taken over signed gaps or absolute gap size. All are resolved only at D1 manifest-writing time — outcome-blind, but unreviewed discretion entering before any gate: §9 places A7 at prelaunch, after D2 and S, so no independent check occurs between the D1 freeze and D2 measurement. This fails the plan's own 'frozen HERE' standard (the R2 floor value is frozen in-plan; these parameters are not). MEDIUM.
findings.required_remediation: Pin the exact formulas in plan bytes (ddof, boundary-sample construction, self-inclusion rule, signed-vs-absolute gap percentile input), or add a D1-manifest audit gate (fresh-context) between the D1 freeze and any D2 measurement so the frozen formulas are independently read before first use.
